page.layout: One title page, all lines centred in one block: a printer's ornament sits between the lines of the imprint at the foot. No running head, page number or catchword. The handwritten "10" top right, the handwritten "7." near the foot and the paper tab "10" on the right edge are not printed and are left out.
page.notes: The ornament between "consuetis" and "ARGENTORATI" is a printer's fleuron, not text. The first line "D. O. M. A:" and the line "CENTURIA CONCLUSIONUM." are set in small capitals and italic respectively, as printed. The line "Præside" is in larger roman type. Spelling of u/v has been normalised; long s is written as plain s; "propofita" was read as "proposita" and "professore" as printed with plain s. The line "Anno XCVI." is italic with the capital letters as printed. No printed page number appears on the page.
